items.headline: CoreWeave falls 5% even as Nvidia reaffirms financing commitments to AI cloud partners
items.note: Nvidia backstop reassurance failed to calm neocloud sentiment; CoreWeave's next debt deal pricing (target 7-7.5% yields) is the key refinancing test.

items.headline: Apollo CEO Rowan warns neocloud financing access could 'disappear'
items.note: A major private-credit lender flags neocloud funding dependence on Nvidia support; commentary, not a realized event.

items.headline: CoreWeave bond yield tops 16% as AI credit stress rises; 5y CDS still ~1,100bp
items.note: CoreWeave unsecured bonds trade at distressed-like yields (~15.7% on Nov 17) with CDS around 1,113bp, showing sustained market-implied default risk.

items.headline: ING shops ~$500M of data center loans at auction, incl. slice tied to Oracle's New Mexico Stargate site
items.note: Lenders offloading Stargate-linked data center loans, alongside a reported Oracle force majeure notice to the site developer, signals weakening syndication appetite.
